description: Department of Labour, Labour Standards Division - Cost of living Index for the month of June 2017 is 124.9 for the Cocoa, Cardamom & Pepper growing & manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper industries, based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits administration, specifically addressing worker compensation matters handled by the Department of Labour, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
